questions: Can one student borrow more than one copy of the same book at a time, and is there a limit on how many books a student can have out in total?
Is a student's name enough to identify them, or should they also give something unique like a student ID, in case two students share a name?
Should adding books be protected (for example with a password) so only the librarian can do it?
answers: No, they just give their name.
